title: Builder project registration - what buyers should verify before booking
p1: A project can look perfect on paper and still create problems later. Before paying a booking amount, many buyers check the location and price but miss one crucial step: verifying the project's registration details.
p2: A common misconception is that a builder's advertisement, brochure, or promise is enough proof of safety. The reality is that registration alone is not the finish line. Buyers should verify whether the registered details match the actual project being offered, including approvals, promised timelines, and key documents.
p3: One detail many people miss: a registered project does not automatically mean every claim made by the seller is approved or guaranteed. Check the official registration record, compare it with the agreement terms, and confirm what is actually included before booking. A few minutes of verification can prevent years of disputes.
